name: pod_fetch
description:
Fetch the FULL body of one or more pods by pod_id. Use this after calling pod_search and deciding which pods are worth opening.

Returns each pod's header plus its body, source_refs, and metadata. Pod_ids that don't exist are reported in the 'missing' list — no error.

inputs.name: pod_ids
inputs.description: List of pod_ids to fetch, e.g. ['datapod:chat_cluster:abc123', 'datapod:chat_cluster:def456'].

outputs.description: Human-readable dump of the fetched pods.
Structured: {pods: [ {full pod incl. body, source_refs, metadata} ], missing: [pod_ids that weren't found]}.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for pod_fetch tool:

- pod_ids (required): list of pod_ids to open. Example: ['datapod:chat_cluster:abc123']
